description: This source file defines serialization and copying logic for ImmutableList<T> in the Orleans framework, including a serializer, surrogate, and deep copier.

classes.name: ImmutableListCodec<T>

classes.description: Surrogate type for ImmutableList<T>, holds list of values for serialization.

classes.description: Implements deep copying logic for ImmutableList<T>.

methods.description: Converts surrogate data back into an ImmutableList<T>.
